{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p="specs/001-transactions/spec.md"
s=open(p).read()
fr_add="""- **FR-014**: `invalidate_many(tags, mode='any')` MUST remove entries
  by tag set: mode `any` removes entries carrying at least one requested
  tag (union); mode `all` removes entries carrying every requested tag;
  it MUST return the number of distinct removed keys (R04).
- **FR-015**: An empty requested tag collection MUST remove zero entries
  in either mode; an invalid `mode` or invalid `tags` MUST raise
  `ValueError` before any mutation (R04).
- **FR-016**: `invalidate(tag)` MUST remain fully compatible with
  `invalidate_many` for single-tag requests (R04).
- **FR-017**: `resize(maxsize)` MUST validate the capacity first (same
  rule as FR-010); a failed resize MUST preserve all state (entries,
  tags, recency order, current capacity); a successful shrink MUST evict
  least-recently-used entries; a successful grow MUST evict nothing;
  surviving entries MUST keep their LRU order; the `maxsize` property
  MUST report the current capacity after a successful resize (R05).
- **FR-018**: Tag iterables (including generators) MUST be consumed
  exactly once per call; on validation failure the cache MUST be
  unchanged (R06).
- **FR-019**: Returned values MUST remain detached across repeated
  `get`s and `put`s, including nested mutable structures (R06).
"""
anchor="- **FR-013"
i=s.index(anchor)
j=s.index("\n",i)
s=s[:j+1]+fr_add+s[j+1:]
# Success criteria: extend FR range and add SC-006
s=s.replace("FR-001..FR-013 are","FR-001..FR-019 are")
sc_add="""- **SC-006**: Bulk invalidation and resize boundary cases (empty tag
  set in both modes, invalid mode, invalid capacity, shrink/grow order
  preservation) each have a passing test with observed output, and the
  superseded design-note behaviors (empty `all` matches every key;
  resize flushes the cache) are demonstrably NOT implemented."""
anchor2="## Assumptions"
s=s.replace(anchor2,sc_add+anchor2,1)
assum_add="""- **Milestone 2 supersession (R04/R05)**: an old generated design
  note claimed \"empty all-tags matches every key and resizing may flush
  the cache\". That prose is superseded by R04 (empty requested tags
  remove zero entries in either mode) and R05 (resize preserves
  surviving entries; a failed resize preserves all state). The spec and
  tests follow R04/R05, not the old note.
- **Claim-A candidate extension, round 2 (2026-09-22) — R05
  clarification on expiry**: the extension text references expiry as
  entry state (\"R07/R08 define the expiry as entry state\"), but no
  R07/R08 expiry requirement exists in the current frozen requirements
  (R01-R06 only). Resolution for this milestone: entries have NO expiry
  attribute; therefore \"preserving absolute expiry across resize\" is
  vacuously satisfied by preserving the entry's stored state exactly as
 -is (no re-copying of value identity beyond the existing deep-copy
  contract, no recomputation of any time-based state). If a future
  milestone adds R07/R08 (TTL/expiry), this assumption MUST be revisited
  and resize MUST then preserve each surviving entry's absolute expiry
  timestamp rather than dropping or recomputing it. Tracked as an open
  item for clarify/plan.
"""
i=s.rindex("- **Claim-A candidate extension (variant")
j=s.index("\n",i)
# append after the end of that assumption paragraph (it ends before file end or next '- **')
rest=s[j+1:]
if rest.startswith("\n"):
    rest=rest[1:]
    s=s[:j+1]+"\n"+assum_add+rest
else:
    s=s[:j+1]+assum_add+rest
open(p,"w").write(s)
print("FR count:", s.count("- **FR-"), "| SC-006:", "SC-006" in s, "| supersession:", "superseded by R04" in s, "| round2:", "round 2" in s)
PYEOF"}
